h33-h33-2-b2-CONCc10-20261023-a9e67bab.hypothesis: Unmapped geothermal-indicative faults cluster at ~1 km with the same H19-5 lineament corridors that already host R0. Relocating the lowest 10% of R0 dots (H19-5-poor blocks) onto unused H19-5 pixels in H19-5-rich blocks raises triangular-kernel credit on line-like new-fault truth.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCc10-20261023-a9e67bab.mechanism: DTI = T/(0.2T + 0.2(S-M) + 0.8|G|), R=300 m. Line-like truth lowers the isolated-dot bar (~0.056 at DTI 0.28). Km-scale concentration matches Great Basin segment length and GeoDAWN ~400 m line-spacing uncertainty. Count, 2 px collar, and sqrt(8) spacing are held fixed so only allocation changes. H19-5 ridges in high-prior 1 km blocks are spacing-saturated (only 79 added dots land on unused H19-5 pixels); remaining adds fill high 5x5-support pixels in those same blocks, holding min sep sqrt(8).
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCc10-20261023-a9e67bab.non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lahontan benches, Miocene caldera rings, and unfaulted intrusive contacts also form km-scale H19-5 ridges; concentrating onto those adds FP_w with no T.

h33-h33-2-b2-CONCc10-20261023-a9e67bab.falsifier: If live RECEIPT drops <= -0.01, km-scale H19-5 concentration is dominated by non-fault ridges or parent allocation is already sufficient. If live rises >= +0.01, advance to c15/c20.

h33-h33-2-b2-CONCc15-20261023-25e403d0.hypothesis: A 15% relocation is large enough to show whether geothermal new-fault mass is km-clustered without emptying entire low-prior corridors that may still host isolated blind splays.

Low-prior singleton 1 km blocks (parent density 1) are drained first; high-prior blocks receive unused H19-5 pixels first. H19-5 ridges in high-prior 1 km blocks are spacing-saturated (only 110 added dots land on unused H19-5 pixels); remaining adds fill high 5x5-support pixels in those same blocks, holding min sep sqrt(8).
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCc15-20261023-25e403d0.non_fault_mimic: Playal shorelines and E-W GeoDAWN flight-line corrugation that survive H19-5 will be amplified 1.5x relative to c10.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCc15-20261023-25e403d0.predicted_sign_size: MODEL predicted live delta +0.002 (range -0.014 to +0.012). Near-null because parent CV 0.619 already sits above 0.51-0.59; after c15 CV=0.786.

h33-h33-2-b2-CONCc20-20261023-03244051.hypothesis: Doubling the relocation to 20% over-concentrates onto the strongest H19-5 corridors, pushing occupied-block CV well above the 0.51-0.59 band of the best historical files and starving isolated new-fault tips.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCc20-20261023-03244051.mechanism: Each relocated dot still costs 0.2 in the DTI denominator. Beyond ~15% the marginal T from packing more dots into already-covered 300 m kernels falls below that cost unless private truth is more clustered than the parent field. H19-5 ridges in high-prior 1 km blocks are spacing-saturated (only 147 added dots land on unused H19-5 pixels); remaining adds fill high 5x5-support pixels in those same blocks, holding min sep sqrt(8).
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCc20-20261023-03244051.non_fault_mimic: Range-front lithologic contacts (gravity/magnetic edges without slip) that H19-5 already over-weights; 20% concentration piles FP_w onto those contacts.

h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPtmi2-20261023-b87ddfc5.hypothesis: GeoDAWN Area 2 was flown at 400 m E-W line spacing and 150-200 m terrain clearance (https://data.usgs.gov/datacatalog/data/USGS:657e1d85d34e23d3533209f7), so the H19-5 ridge positions that seeded R0 are uncertain by roughly the 300 m scoring-kernel radius. Where the smoothed TMI horizontal-gradient magnitude (band 3, tmi_hg) peaks within 2 px of an R0 dot, that crest is a better estimate of the magnetic-basement step (the fault) than the ridge seed, and re-centering dots on crests converts partial kernel credit into full credit.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPtmi2-20261023-b87ddfc5.mechanism: Move each of the 37,654 R0 dots <= 2 px (Euclidean, 13-pixel window) to the argmax of the 3x3-smoothed tmi_hg field; destination must stay inside the footprint at d_cat > 2 px (R0's own exclusion); count fixed; deterministic row-major processing, own-pixel-wins ties. DTI = T/(0.2T + 0.2(S-M) + 0.8|G|): mass S is unchanged, so only kernel credit T and the S-M term can move; a 100-200 m re-centering onto the true trace raises K_300 overlap on line-like truth (bar ~0.056 at DTI 0.28 for isolated truth, lower for lines).
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPtmi2-20261023-b87ddfc5.non_fault_mimic: Flight-line corrugation residual between 400 m-spaced lines, cultural magnetics (pipelines, powerlines), Tertiary dike swarms and caldera ring-fracture crests, and sharp lithologic contacts all produce tmi_hg crests with no Quaternary fault; snapping can walk dots onto them.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPtmi2-20261023-b87ddfc5.predicted_live_change: +0.002 to +0.010 DTI [MODEL] vs R0 (treat |delta| < 0.01 on public chunks as no evidence).
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPtmi2-20261023-b87ddfc5.falsifier: Live public score drops by >= 0.01 vs R0's receipt: the H19-5 ridge positions are already at or better than the tmi_hg crest, or snapping systematically walks dots onto non-fault crests.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPtmi2-20261023-b87ddfc5.exclusions: destination requires footprint & d_cat > 2.0 px (identical to R0's exclusion)

h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPgrav2-20261023-ac2bdb06.hypothesis: The isostatic-gravity horizontal gradient (band 18, iso_grav_anom_hg) marks the density contrast across basin-margin normal faults independently of magnetics: where basin fill thinks against range front, the Bouguer step tracks the fault even where TMI is blurred by remagnetised volcanics. Re-centering R0 dots on gravity-gradient crests tests a second, physically independent positioning signal.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPgrav2-20261023-ac2bdb06.mechanism: Identical SNAP operator and exclusions as tmi2, but the edge field is the 3x3-smoothed iso_grav_anom_hg band. Count fixed at 37,654; <= 2 px displacement; d_cat > 2 px preserved.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPgrav2-20261023-ac2bdb06.non_fault_mimic: Isostatic-gravity compilations are smooth (station spacing km-scale): crests can mark paleo-basin edges, buried pluton margins, or compaction-driven density gradients in sediments rather than active fault scarps; the 100 m grid oversamples that smoothness.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPgrav2-20261023-ac2bdb06.predicted_live_change: -0.002 to +0.006 DTI [MODEL] vs R0 (weaker positional information at 100-200 m scale).
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPgrav2-20261023-ac2bdb06.falsifier: grav2 beats tmi2 by >= +0.01 live (gravity edges beat magnetic edges at 100-200 m), or grav2 falls >= 0.01 below R0 (gravity-crest snapping actively harms placement).
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPgrav2-20261023-ac2bdb06.exclusions: destination requires footprint & d_cat > 2.0 px (identical to R0's exclusion)

h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPcomb2-20261023-bf0a7e2b.hypothesis: Basin-margin normal faults in the Great Basin usually produce BOTH a magnetic basement step and a Bouguer step; single-sensor crests include sensor-specific noise (flight-line corrugation for TMI; compilation smoothing for gravity). The equal-weight rank-composite crest requires partial agreement of both sensors, so snap targets should be more often real fault traces than either single field's argmax.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPcomb2-20261023-bf0a7e2b.mechanism: Identical SNAP operator; edge field = 0.5 * (rank(smoothed tmi_hg) + rank(smoothed iso_grav_anom_hg)) over footprint pixels, which equalises the sensors' units and dynamic ranges before averaging. Count fixed; <= 2 px; d_cat > 2 px preserved.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPcomb2-20261023-bf0a7e2b.non_fault_mimic: Coincident magnetic + gravity gradients also occur at caldera resurgent-dome margins and at major lithologic boundaries (e.g., granite-diorite contacts with density contrast), so agreement filters noise but not all non-fault structure.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPcomb2-20261023-bf0a7e2b.predicted_live_change: +0.002 to +0.008 DTI [MODEL] vs R0 (hedge between tmi2 and grav2 outcomes).
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPcomb2-20261023-bf0a7e2b.falsifier: comb2 lands >= 0.01 below BOTH tmi2 and R0 live, i.e., averaging the sensors destroys usable positional information that each sensor holds separately.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPcomb2-20261023-bf0a7e2b.exclusions: destination requires footprint & d_cat > 2.0 px (identical to R0's exclusion)
